entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer supporting multi-level states for Users, Sessions, and Agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available via an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.

entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent memory provider uses the viking:// protocol and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token spend. It offers observable retrieval through directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges. It supports scoped data access for team-based use cases and provides synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system supports long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and is accessible via Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: The upstream library for the honcho-self-hosted wrapper, this library provides a FastAPI server for managed or self-hosted use. It supports Python and TypeScript SDKs and offers hybrid search with prompt-ready context injection.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system with sub-100ms latency and an interactive TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency memory system uses a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and provides a Python SDK for direct operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system incorporates vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive context harness that generates playbooks, hints, and datasets from agent runs. It supports Python and TypeScript and provides MCP server functionality for tool access.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This lossless context management plugin uses a SQLite-backed message store and a hierarchical DAG to build depth-aware summary nodes. It provides agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports OpenAI-compatible LLM providers or local inference servers and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets to provide portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients. It automates memory creation from transcripts and imported files, reporting 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It is designed for multi-agent systems and provides local-first, zero-cost search for clients including Hermes.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval through BM25 and vector search and integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens, featuring native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, long-term memory architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family that includes a Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every retrieval. It features recency ranking, contradiction tracking, and a self-directing loop for knowledge gaps.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server using local-first SQLite-vec storage.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores information as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for coding agents.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It supports stdio and SSE MCP servers and renders context to assistant-specific files.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces tool-schema overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin supports immediate event deletion and provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer to manage agent memory.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging via USDC and stablecoins across multiple blockchain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate agent payments.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It can be executed via a native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides five native tools for managing and searching local artifacts. It features a proactive router skill and an opt-in process for automatic tool-OKF generation.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search method combining BM25, vector, and graph techniques, and includes automatic context checkpointing.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories via localhost. It supports semantic and literal code search, including grounded Q&A with file-and-line citations.

entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 822 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It provides ready-to-paste exports for use with ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and Codex.

entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set provides access to YouTube transcripts, search, channels, and playlists via TranscriptAPI. It is compatible with the Agent Skills format and works across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf.

entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents through a three-level work model. It utilizes file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.

It reduces token consumption and features graceful degradation if specific embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.

entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It analyzes various file formats to detect issues such as conflicting directives or missing limits using HERM v1.1 scoring.

entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
